name: mdrv_confirm_upload
description: Step 2 of an upload. Call AFTER the bytes have been PUT to the presigned `upload_url` from mdrv_presign_upload. Pass the same `s3_key` you got back. The server verifies the object landed, reads its real size, and creates the file record (using the name/folder/content_type captured at presign time). Requires the write scope. Returns the created file including its new `id`.
